data.summary: Fitnesswerk Beispielstark welcomes Johanna Beispielacker as a new member: the membership starts on 1 January 2027 with a 12-month initial term and a monthly fee of €34.00, and she may train for free until then.
data.explanation: This is a welcome letter confirming your new gym contract. No action is needed right now — you can already train for free before the membership officially starts. The contract runs for an initial 12 months and then continues on a monthly basis unless cancelled in time; the app will track and show you the exact notice deadline before the initial term ends. Keep this letter for your records, especially the membership number and the fee amount in case of future billing questions.
